mentions.name: panoptic.live
mentions.description: This site lets users tile and watch multiple videos from different platforms (YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, Kick) at once by dragging and dropping links into a grid. It supports reloading or removing streams without refreshing, saving mixes for later, and sharing mixes as links. It runs entirely in the browser with no backend or login and works best on very large screens.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a site that lets you tile and watch multiple videos from different platforms all at once.
